custom_logic_notes: The CBH_BH_Stoch custom signal filter is the core trading logic. Its internal implementation (crossover rules, MA interaction with Stochastic) is encapsulated in the external .mqh file. The CExpertSignal base class uses a voting mechanism: the filter's Weight (1.0) multiplies its vote, and the result is compared against ThresholdOpen (40) and ThresholdClose (20). SL/TP are both set to 0.0 meaning the EA relies entirely on signal reversal for exits. Pending orders are used with 4-bar expiration. Expert_EveryTick=false means the EA processes signals on new bar completion only.
python_conversion_notes: The main challenge is reverse-engineering the CBH_BH_Stoch signal logic from the .mqh file. Once the Stochastic(47,9,13) + MA(5) combination rules are understood, the rest is straightforward: threshold-based entry (>=40 open, <=20 close), fixed lot sizing, no SL/TP, no trailing stop. The CExpert framework handles pending order creation with 4-bar expiration which needs to be replicated. The on-bar processing model (EveryTick=false) simplifies conversion to a bar-based backtest loop.
